skills.name: Thalassophobia
skills.desc: Kadita gains the Blessing of the Ocean every 30s. Taking damage from an enemy hero triggers the Blessing for 4s. When the duration ends, she recovers 65% of the HP lost during this time (damage from minions and creeps does not trigger this effect).

skills.name: Ocean Ode
skills.desc: Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain. Use Again: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

skills.name: Breath of the Ocean
skills.desc: After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s. Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

skills.name: Rough Waves
skills.desc: Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), each dealing 270 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit. When underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.
